macros.name: AIDactivate
macros.doc: Use \AIDactivate{} to check specific items in the taxonomy.

macros.name: AIDconfig
macros.doc: The \AIDconfig command is a universal setter for content, visuals, and strings.

macros.name: AIDdiscloseTitle
macros.doc: Change the default section title and hierarchy level using \AIDdiscloseTitle.

macros.name: AIDGetString
macros.doc: Returns the localized string associated with a specific internal key.

macros.name: AIDloadLanguage
macros.doc: Manually forces the loading of a specific language definition file, overriding the auto-detection.

macros.name: AIDorder
macros.doc: Use \AIDorder to define the sequence of the disclosure components.

macros.name: AIDpreamble
macros.doc: You can modify internal strings using \AIDstrings and the main preamble paragraph using \AIDpreamble.

macros.name: AIDset
macros.doc: The \AIDset command allows you to change package load-time options dynamically in the preamble.

macros.name: AIDstrings
macros.doc: You can modify internal strings using \AIDstrings and the main preamble paragraph using \AIDpreamble.

macros.name: AIDtoolsUsed
macros.doc: Use \AIDtoolsUsed{} to list the AI tools employed.

envs.name: AIDcomment
envs.doc: Use the AIDcomment (numbered) and AIDcomment* (unnumbered) environments for details.
